wallpapers.title: Masters of the surf and shore
wallpapers.caption: California sea lions, offshore Mexico, Pacific Ocean
wallpapers.desc: A day at the beach is rarely quiet when California sea lions are around. With their booming barks, playful personalities, and a knack for stealing the spotlight, these marine mammals know how to put on a show.
